reason: A DeepSeek Harness knowledge-management plugin for persistent, searchable knowledge bases with local or remote storage, model-assisted extraction, review workflows, and web administration.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供支持本地或远程存储的持久化知识库、检索、模型辅助提取、审核写入和 Web 管理功能。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with persistent local or remote knowledge bases, search, model-assisted extraction, review workflows, and web administration.

capabilities: Stores and retrieves persistent knowledge in local SQLite or a remote service
Automatically extracts and writes knowledge after responses according to configured policies
Provides search and read tools plus knowledge-base creation and update tools
Exposes an authenticated HTTP API with client token and administrative management
Provides a web interface for browsing documents, reviewing candidates, and managing entries
